Hi Naomi / team,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Blue Haven Labs is ready to move forward with the platform pilot, but we ran into an internal complication on the tax side that affects PO issuance: they have two active EINs (one for R&D services, one for EU consulting) and their accounting team can only produce a notarized W-9 for the primary EIN by next week.

They can immediately provide a bank-issued letter confirming the primary EIN and a signed delegation form that authorizes the primary EIN for invoicing. For the secondary EIN they can either provide a notarized W-9 (longer timeline) or a signed affiliate attestation.

Request: can Redwood provision a conditional PO for an initial pilot invoice (not to exceed $25,000) while we collect the notarized W-9 for the secondary EIN? If not, what exact evidence would satisfy procurement to start an initial payment run?

Attachments: vendor_certificates.pdf (contains corporate registration + draft delegation form)

We'd like to close this week so the pilot billing can start. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk the docs.

—Marco

Hi Marco — thanks for the summary and the attachment. Good to meet briefly earlier.

Short answer: yes, we can issue a conditional PO for the pilot with the following requirements:
- Redwood will issue a provisional PO (PO-2027-1189) capped at $25,000 to allow the first invoice to be processed.
- Final release of funds requires either (A) notarized W-9 for the invoicing EIN, or (B) bank letter + completed delegated-signer form signed by an authorized officer.
- For multi-EIN vendors, we need explicit mapping on company letterhead showing which EIN maps to which product line.

Please have Blue Haven provide (1) the bank letter (PDF), (2) the signed delegated-signer form, and (3) a short affiliate attestation for the secondary EIN if available. Once we receive items (1) and (2) procurement will move the PO from "provisional" to "staged" and accounting will schedule the first payment run.

I’m copying Ben (Vendor Ops) and Kimberly (Payments) to coordinate the PO and compliance check. Ben — can you set up the provisional PO and attach the standard conditional terms? Kimberly — if we get the bank letter + delegated form, is there any additional KYC you’ll require for this pilot?
